blocks.title: 听前定位与原创对话
blocks.content:
听力先抓场景、说话人关系与交谈目的，再记录能区分选项的细节。阅读下面的原创对话时，可以先遮住文本，由同伴朗读；第二遍再核对关键词。听到一个熟悉词并不意味着找到了答案，还要判断谁说了什么、建议是否被接受。口头回应时用完整短句说明自己的选择，并给出一个与对话一致的理由。不要把听前预测当成听后事实，也不要因为人物语气友好就推断他们已经达成了所有安排。

Mia: Is the lantern evening only for people who live on this street?
Noah: No. Everyone is welcome. We gather in the square at six.
Mia: Should I buy a new lantern?
Noah: You do not have to. We are making lanterns from used paper so that less material is wasted.
Mia: What happens after the lights are switched on?
Noah: Older neighbours tell stories, and children explain the pictures on their lanterns.
Mia: That sounds meaningful. I can bring paper and help clean the square afterwards.
Noah: Great. The celebration matters because people do things together.

blocks.title: 信息路径：场景—建议—理由
blocks.content: 本单元听说场景是 a neighbourhood lantern evening。先完成信息表：人物是谁、正在解决什么问题、提出了哪些建议、最终准备怎样做。对话中的具体证据包括：The lantern evening is open to everyone, starts at six and uses lanterns made from used paper. 再用它检查你记录的关键词是否属于同一件事。听力记录可以简写，但复述时要恢复完整逻辑，不要把建议写成已经发生的结果。

blocks.title: 区分听到的信息与自己的推测
blocks.content: 容易混淆的不是两个孤立单词，而是信息的确定程度。Noah explains both the practical arrangement and the reason for reusing paper; Mia's offer to help follows that explanation. 把人物的计划、解释与最终行动分别写在三栏中；如果对话只说 could 或 may，就不要在答案里改成肯定发生。语言上还需留意：a traditional custom（传统习俗）中的 traditional 是形容词；tradition 是名词，不能直接写成 a tradition custom。 用同一主题的新句子举例，比脱离语境反复抄写单词更能检查理解。

blocks.title: 双人角色任务
blocks.content:
角色任务：两人重组关于 a neighbourhood lantern evening 的对话。一人保留原来的目标，另一人更换一个条件，例如时间、参与者或可用材料；先提出一个清楚的问题，再给出有理由的回应。可参考的表达是：The children carrying lanterns are gathering near the bridge.

以下是同一组说话人的原创角色练习示例，保留本节场景并增加一个明确条件，不需要先阅读其他板块：
Mia: I can come at six, but my friend will arrive a little later. Is that all right?
Noah: Yes. Everyone is welcome. Could you meet her at the entrance so she knows where to go?
Mia: Certainly. We can both bring used paper.
Noah: Thank you. The group making lanterns will show you where the spare frames are.
Mia: Then we will join the work before listening to the neighbours' stories.

blocks.title: A Lantern That Carried a Story · 原创阅读
blocks.content:
阅读先用标题预测内容，再用段落中的动作、转折和结果检查预测。区分文章主旨、明确细节与推断：主旨要覆盖全文，细节可以回到原句定位，推断则需要把文本证据与合理解释连接起来。下面的短文为原创演示文章。先找主人公起初的想法，再标出促使想法变化的事件，最后解释结尾的反思怎样回扣开头。不要把一个例子扩大成所有人的共同经历。

On Friday afternoon, Lin found an old map in a drawer. Instead of buying colourful paper for the neighbourhood lantern evening, she used the map to cover a simple frame. She drew a small tree on one side and left the street names visible. At first she worried that her lantern would look less beautiful than the others.

When the neighbours gathered in the square, an older woman recognised a street that no longer existed. She told the children about the shop where she had bought her first schoolbag. Other neighbours began to share their memories. Lin realised that the map had given them something to talk about.

By the end of the evening, the lantern was not the brightest object in the square, but several people had asked to see it. Lin wrote one sentence in her diary: a tradition stays alive when people add their own stories to it. The next morning, she helped collect the used paper and saved the frame for another year.

blocks.title: 情节与证据链
blocks.content: 文章的证据链可以画成三步：recognised a street → shared memories → asked to see the lantern。每一个箭头都需要用文本中的动作或话语说明，不能只凭主题名称猜测。核心细节是：Lin used an old map because she wanted to reuse material; its visible street names later encouraged neighbours to share memories. 用这条细节回答“发生了什么”，再用文章结尾回答“人物学到了什么”。若两个选项都涉及主题，应优先选择能覆盖人物起点、事件和结果的表达，而不是范围过大或只说一段内容的表达。

blocks.title: 主旨、细节与推断
blocks.content: 本文主旨是：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 这是对全文的概括；它与一条事实细节不同，也比“这是一篇关于 节日与庆祝 的文章”更具体。合理推断是：Lin's worry changes into confidence because other people find meaning in her lantern, not because it wins a prize. 推断需要证据但不是原句照抄。评价人物时先指出文本行为，再提出解释，不能因为文章主题积极就假定人物没有犹豫、没有成本或获得了奖励。

blocks.title: 有证据的复述
blocks.content:
用以下顺序做一次英文复述：人物最初的想法 → 促使想法变化的细节 → 最后的理解。复述时可使用 at first、however、by the end 等衔接语，但必须让连接词反映真实关系。下面是同主题写作拓展材料，事件与本节阅读一致，可帮助比较叙述角度；它不是阅读题的新增证据：

Saturday, clear

Yesterday I joined our neighbourhood lantern evening for the first time. Before sunset, we put handmade lanterns around the square. Mine was covered with an old map, and I felt nervous when I placed it beside the colourful ones.

The most memorable moment came when a neighbour recognised a street name on my lantern. She told us a story about her childhood, and soon other people were sharing their memories. I had thought the evening would be mainly about lights, but the conversations made it special.

Afterwards, we collected the paper and kept the frames for next year. I went home feeling grateful. A celebration can connect people when everyone brings something of their own.

最后给短文换一个标题，并用一个文本细节解释新标题为什么合适。

blocks.title: 现在分词作定语和表语
blocks.content:
本节从完整语境中观察结构，而不是只记住一个名称。先圈出例句中的目标形式，指出它修饰或补充说明的对象，再尝试改写成意思相近的完整句。对比正确句与易错句时，必须说清错误改变了哪一种语法关系；只说“读起来不顺”不能帮助修改。最后用本单元的新情境写两句自己的句子，检查意思是否清楚，再检查词形、时态和逻辑主语。

现在分词作定语时可以说明名词主动进行的动作：the children carrying lanterns 指正在提灯的孩子，carrying 与 children 是主动关系。短分词通常前置，较长的分词短语常放在名词后面；the lanterns hanging over the square 中 hanging over the square 修饰 lanterns。分词作表语还可说明事物的性质：The celebration is exciting. 不要把 exciting 与 excited 混淆，前者说活动使人兴奋，后者说人感到兴奋。现在分词形式本身不保证事件发生在说话的此刻，应结合主句时态和上下文判断。

blocks.title: 结构—对象—作用
blocks.content: 语法关系图的中心句是：The children carrying lanterns are gathering near the bridge. 先找句子主干，再标出目标结构及其说明的对象。可以把目标部分展开或改写，确认意思没有被改变。现在分词作定语时可以说明名词主动进行的动作：the children carrying lanterns 指正在提灯的孩子，carrying 与 children 是主动关系。短分词通常前置，较长的分词短语常放在名词后面；the lanterns hanging over the square 中 hanging over the square 修饰 lanterns。分词作表语还可说明事物的性质：The celebration is exciting. 不要把 exciting 与 excited 混淆，前者说活动使人兴奋，后者说人感到兴奋。现在分词形式本身不保证事件发生在说话的此刻，应结合主句时态和上下文判断。 将“形式、依附对象、表达作用”分别放进三格，遇到新句子时按同样顺序分析，而不是只看是否出现 to 或 -ing 就直接下结论。

blocks.title: 正确句与易错句
blocks.content:
正确示例：The children carrying lanterns are gathering near the bridge.
易错示例：The children carried lanterns are gathering near the bridge.

此处要用后置定语说明孩子主动提着灯笼，carrying lanterns 可以展开为 who are carrying lanterns；carried 不构成这里所需的主动修饰关系。 修改完成后还要检验主题意思有没有变化。错误句不是为了机械记忆一个禁用词，而是帮助发现词形、结构和语义之间的联系。请再写一个与 a neighbourhood lantern evening 相关的新例句，指出目标结构起什么作用，并用中文解释句意。

blocks.title: 放进新的主题情境
blocks.content:
迁移任务：阅读下面的原创情境，然后用本节结构写两句补充说明。第一句描述人物、物品或行为，第二句说明理由、目的或说话人的立场；具体用途以本节语法为准。写好后交换检查，先指出逻辑关系，再提出修改。下面是同主题应用对话，作为原创拓展情境，不是本节语法题所依赖的额外前文：

Host: What did you enjoy most about the lantern evening?
Guest: I especially enjoyed the stories. The lantern made from a map reminded people of their old street.
Host: Was anything different from what you expected?
Guest: Yes. I expected a colourful show, but we spent more time talking than watching.
Host: How did you feel at the end?
Guest: I felt closer to my neighbours. Next year I would like to invite the new families on the street.
Host: That is a thoughtful idea. Could you help design an invitation?
Guest: Certainly. It should explain that visitors can bring a story as well as a lantern.

blocks.title: 回应与追问 · 原创对话
blocks.content:
互动交流要先回应对方已经表达的意思，再补充自己的观点。复述时可以使用 So you mean ...，追问时用 Could you explain ...，表达不同看法时先说明依据。下面的对话围绕本单元具体事件展开。练习时两人交换角色：一人提出追问，一人用一个文本细节回答。避免只背一段独白而不听问题，也不要把自己的观点放进对方口中。谈话结束前用一句话确认下一步或共同理解。

Host: What did you enjoy most about the lantern evening?
Guest: I especially enjoyed the stories. The lantern made from a map reminded people of their old street.
Host: Was anything different from what you expected?
Guest: Yes. I expected a colourful show, but we spent more time talking than watching.
Host: How did you feel at the end?
Guest: I felt closer to my neighbours. Next year I would like to invite the new families on the street.
Host: That is a thoughtful idea. Could you help design an invitation?
Guest: Certainly. It should explain that visitors can bring a story as well as a lantern.

blocks.title: 互动中的证据路线
blocks.content: 本节互动路径不是轮流背诵，而是“听清问题 → 回应问题 → 提供依据 → 确认理解”。讨论中的可用证据是：The guest enjoyed the neighbours' stories and would like to invite new families next year. 可表达的理解是：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 回答追问时从证据出发；如果问题涉及文本没有说明的内容，可以说 The text does not tell us ...，然后把话题拉回已经知道的事实，保持对话真实。记录同伴追问的关键词，并检查你的回答是否正面回应了问题。

blocks.title: 理解、赞同与追问
blocks.content: 对话中的赞同、追问与不同意见应当区分。I see what you mean. 表示理解对方，不一定是完全同意；Could you explain why ...? 是索取理由，不是直接否定。把本节对话的具体意思讲清楚：The guest contrasts an expected colourful show with an actual evening of stories and conversations; inviting new families is a future idea. 若只重复主题词 Festivals and Celebrations，听者仍不知道你依据了什么。语言方面还应检查：a traditional custom（传统习俗）中的 traditional 是形容词；tradition 是名词，不能直接写成 a tradition custom。 再用一个完整句替换含混的评价。

blocks.title: 三人对话任务
blocks.content:

Design a small cultural display called 'One Object, One Story'. Choose a festival object, such as a paper lantern, and write a label of 60–80 words. blocks.title: A Short Festival Diary · 原创范文
blocks.content:
写作先确定读者和目的，再安排信息。本节的原创范文展示了主题内容如何通过具体细节展开。阅读时标出开头交代的情境、中间最重要的事件或理由，以及结尾表达的感受或判断。修改时先检查内容是否能回答写作任务，再检查段落衔接和语法。用词准确比堆砌形容词更重要；每一个评价都应有可观察的动作、对话或事实支撑，而不是连续使用 interesting、good 或 great。

Saturday, clear

Yesterday I joined our neighbourhood lantern evening for the first time. Before sunset, we put handmade lanterns around the square. Mine was covered with an old map, and I felt nervous when I placed it beside the colourful ones.

The most memorable moment came when a neighbour recognised a street name on my lantern. She told us a story about her childhood, and soon other people were sharing their memories. I had thought the evening would be mainly about lights, but the conversations made it special.

Afterwards, we collected the paper and kept the frames for next year. I went home feeling grateful. A celebration can connect people when everyone brings something of their own.

blocks.title: 段落各自承担什么作用
blocks.content: 范文可以按“情境或立场 → 关键细节 → 结果或反思”整理。它围绕 a neighbourhood lantern evening 展开，关键内容是：Lin used an old map because she wanted to reuse material; its visible street names later encouraged neighbours to share memories. 结尾的中心意思是：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 每一段应承担不同作用，不要把结尾写成开头的简单重复。选择连接词之前先说清两句之间是时间、原因、转折还是递进关系；只有关系明确，衔接词才真正帮助读者理解。

blocks.title: 具体细节与空泛评价
blocks.content: 把空泛评价改成有细节的表达。例如只写 It was good. 没有说明为什么，而写出人物的行动和影响，读者就能判断事件的意义。当前主题可使用的具体理解是：Lin's worry changes into confidence because other people find meaning in her lantern, not because it wins a prize. 语法检查还应留意：此处要用后置定语说明孩子主动提着灯笼，carrying lanterns 可以展开为 who are carrying lanterns；carried 不构成这里所需的主动修饰关系。 修改时先处理观点与事实是否一致，再检查单词形式；不要因为句子更长就认为表达一定更好。

blocks.title: 自评应该检查什么
blocks.content:
自评不是重新背诵一遍单词表，而是检查能否在新情境中调动语言。先独立完成下面的纠错、释义和表达任务，再说明每一项选择的理由。把错误分成词义、搭配、句法和篇章四类，找出你真正需要复习的部分。遇到不确定的句子，回到本单元例句进行比较。能认出正确句和能自己写出正确句是两种能力；完成选择题后，还应做一次不看答案的口头或书面表达。

现在分词作定语时可以说明名词主动进行的动作：the children carrying lanterns 指正在提灯的孩子，carrying 与 children 是主动关系。短分词通常前置，较长的分词短语常放在名词后面；the lanterns hanging over the square 中 hanging over the square 修饰 lanterns。分词作表语还可说明事物的性质：The celebration is exciting. 不要把 exciting 与 excited 混淆，前者说活动使人兴奋，后者说人感到兴奋。现在分词形式本身不保证事件发生在说话的此刻，应结合主句时态和上下文判断。

blocks.title: 词汇—结构—篇章
blocks.content: 把本单元整理成三层知识图：主题词汇用于谈论 节日与庆祝，句法结构用于表达关系，文章证据用于支撑观点。词汇示例是 celebration 和 tradition，关键搭配有 decorate ... with ... / be grateful for ... / take part in ...。结构示例是：The children carrying lanterns are gathering near the bridge.。篇章核心是：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 三层之间可以互相检查，但不能用记住一个词代替理解一整段话。把一个关键词放回原句，再口头解释它与全文观点的关系。

blocks.title: 认出答案与独立表达
blocks.content:
本节自检材料：The moving story told by the neighbour made the children feel moved. The lanterns hanging over the square looked simple but meaningful.

请先解释每句意思，再判断目标结构的作用。词汇方面需辨析：a traditional custom（传统习俗）中的 traditional 是形容词；tradition 是名词，不能直接写成 a tradition custom。 语法方面要能说明：此处要用后置定语说明孩子主动提着灯笼，carrying lanterns 可以展开为 who are carrying lanterns；carried 不构成这里所需的主动修饰关系。 如果你只是在选项中认出了正确句，还要遮住选项重新表达一次；如果自己写错了，标出错误类型并写出一个新例句，而不是只抄一遍标准答案。

blocks.content:
综合输出任务：用三到四句英文说明你对 节日与庆祝 的理解。第一句给观点，第二句给具体细节，第三句解释细节为什么支持观点；必要时再补充一个限制。可用的细节是：Lin used an old map because she wanted to reuse material; its visible street names later encouraged neighbours to share memories.。再完成下面的原创迁移练习：

Then replace a vague adjective such as nice with a more precise one, such as welcoming or memorable. Check that the invitation gives a time and a meeting place.

blocks.title: 项目任务书
blocks.content:
项目学习需要一个清楚的作品和可以检查的标准。本节任务不是收集越多信息越好，而是让听众理解一个主题。先确定作品用途和读者，再分配搜集、写作、校对与展示的工作；所有成员都应能解释作品的关键内容。把同伴反馈转成具体修改，例如补充一个原因、删除无依据的概括或改写不清楚的句子。展示后用一条证据说明作品改进了什么，而不是仅报告大家完成了分工。

Design a small cultural display called 'One Object, One Story'. Choose a festival object, such as a paper lantern, and write a label of 60–80 words. Your label should name the object, describe how people use it, and explain a memory or value connected with it. Invite two classmates to check whether a visitor from another community could understand the label without extra background information. Keep a record of their questions and revise the wording. You may use drawings instead of buying objects. End your display with a question that encourages visitors to share their own traditions rather than rank different festivals.

blocks.title: 从任务到修改
blocks.content: 项目路径为“确定问题 → 制作初稿 → 同伴测试 → 根据反馈修改”。当前作品与 a neighbourhood lantern evening 有关，重点不是装饰，而是让读者看懂：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 可以利用的具体情境是：Lin used an old map because she wanted to reuse material; its visible street names later encouraged neighbours to share memories. 检查每一部分是否服务于作品目的，并记录一处实际修改以及修改理由。小组中每个人都应能解释一条核心信息，而不是只有写作者能够回答问题。

blocks.title: 做完与说清楚的区别
blocks.content: 任务完成与作品有效并不是同一件事。交齐资料说明完成了步骤，读者能理解并找到依据才说明表达有效。当前主题中容易过度概括的地方是：Lin's worry changes into confidence because other people find meaning in her lantern, not because it wins a prize. 因此展示时应分清你观察到的事实、人物的观点和小组的解释。语言检查可从这一条易错点开始：a traditional custom（传统习俗）中的 traditional 是形容词；tradition 是名词，不能直接写成 a tradition custom。 让同伴提出一个你没有预先准备的问题，再观察作品能否帮助作答。

blocks.title: 原创短片分镜与旁白
blocks.content:
观看短片时同时关注画面、字幕和旁白。画面能显示动作与顺序，字幕可能概括主题，旁白则补充画面中看不到的原因；三者并不总是逐字重复。下面提供本地演示短片的原创分镜脚本，可在没有音频的情况下先读画面说明，再用旁白核对理解。练习时先描述你看见什么，再解释其含义，避免把自己的推测当成镜头明确展示的事实。最后用三句话复述从开头到结尾的变化。

Frame 1, 0–2 seconds: A plain paper lantern and an old map appear on a table. Caption: 'An ordinary object can carry a memory.'
Frame 2, 2–4 seconds: The lantern is placed in a square. Neighbours point to a visible street name and begin a conversation. Caption: 'Stories connect generations.'
Frame 3, 4–6 seconds: People collect the paper and keep the lantern frame. Caption: 'A living tradition can also change.'
Voice-over: 'Look beyond the lights. Notice who joins the celebration, what they share, and how they care for the place afterwards.'

blocks.title: 三镜头叙事线
blocks.content: 三幅画面的主题路线是：准备可再用的灯笼 → 分享街区故事 → 保留传统并加入新意。第一步交代情境，中间展示关键行动，最后揭示结果或主题。把每一幅画面能直接看到的信息写在左栏，把需要由旁白或上下文解释的意义写在右栏。可用于解释的主题句是：Personal stories and shared participation can give an old celebration new meaning. 如果镜头只给出一个例子，就不能把它扩展为关于所有人的结论；复述时用具体人物和具体动作限定范围。

blocks.title: 画面事实与意义解释
blocks.content: 观看任务要区分描述和解释。描述回答“画面展示了什么”，解释回答“这个细节为什么有意义”。当前故事的关键解释是：Lin's worry changes into confidence because other people find meaning in her lantern, not because it wins a prize. 若暂时关闭旁白，只依据画面能够确认哪些内容？恢复旁白后又补充了什么？用本单元词汇复述时还需注意：a traditional custom（传统习俗）中的 traditional 是形容词；tradition 是名词，不能直接写成 a tradition custom。 保持语言与证据一致，比把每一个镜头都赋予宏大意义更准确。

blocks.title: 配音与字幕练习
blocks.content:
配音与字幕任务：两人选择本节三幅分镜，一人用三句英文描述动作，另一人用一句主题句解释它们的联系。随后交换角色，检查画面信息与评价是否分开。可以参考下面明确标出的同主题讨论拓展；其中人物的解释可帮助练习说法，但不能当作短片画面直接展示的事实：

Host: What did you enjoy most about the lantern evening?
Guest: I especially enjoyed the stories. The lantern made from a map reminded people of their old street.
Host: Was anything different from what you expected?
Guest: Yes. I expected a colourful show, but we spent more time talking than watching.
Host: How did you feel at the end?
Guest: I felt closer to my neighbours. Next year I would like to invite the new families on the street.
Host: That is a thoughtful idea. Could you help design an invitation?
Guest: Certainly. It should explain that visitors can bring a story as well as a lantern.

完成后让第三位同学只看字幕复述短片；如果复述与原脚本明显不同，就修改含混的主语、时间顺序或代词指向。

blocks.title: 听前定位与原创对话
blocks.content:
听力先抓场景、说话人关系与交谈目的，再记录能区分选项的细节。阅读下面的原创对话时，可以先遮住文本，由同伴朗读；第二遍再核对关键词。听到一个熟悉词并不意味着找到了答案，还要判断谁说了什么、建议是否被接受。口头回应时用完整短句说明自己的选择，并给出一个与对话一致的理由。不要把听前预测当成听后事实，也不要因为人物语气友好就推断他们已经达成了所有安排。

Maya: We have one free seat, but two people are waiting. What should we do?
Eli: We could ask whether either person needs the seat urgently.
Maya: I do not want to make assumptions from their appearance.
Eli: Then let us explain the situation and ask them politely.
Maya: Good idea. We can also bring a chair from the next room.
Eli: I will check with the librarian first.
Maya: Thank you. Making a fair choice sometimes means finding more information, not deciding faster.
Eli: And if we make a mistake, we should explain it and correct it.

blocks.title: 信息路径：场景—建议—理由
blocks.content: 本单元听说场景是 a school library and a community reading room。先完成信息表：人物是谁、正在解决什么问题、提出了哪些建议、最终准备怎样做。对话中的具体证据包括：The volunteers plan to ask visitors politely and check with the librarian before bringing another chair. 再用它检查你记录的关键词是否属于同一件事。听力记录可以简写，但复述时要恢复完整逻辑，不要把建议写成已经发生的结果。

blocks.title: 区分听到的信息与自己的推测
blocks.content: 容易混淆的不是两个孤立单词，而是信息的确定程度。Maya and Eli do not claim to know the waiting visitors' needs; they propose a polite question and a practical way to add a seat. 把人物的计划、解释与最终行动分别写在三栏中；如果对话只说 could 或 may，就不要在答案里改成肯定发生。语言上还需留意：patient 作“耐心的”时常接 with：be patient with a young reader；patience 才是“耐心”这个名词。 用同一主题的新句子举例，比脱离语境反复抄写单词更能检查理解。

blocks.title: 双人角色任务
blocks.content:
角色任务：两人重组关于 a school library and a community reading room 的对话。一人保留原来的目标，另一人更换一个条件，例如时间、参与者或可用材料；先提出一个清楚的问题，再给出有理由的回应。可参考的表达是：Seeing an older visitor waiting, Maya offered to find a seat for him.

以下是同一组说话人的原创角色练习示例，保留本节场景并增加一个明确条件，不需要先阅读其他板块：
Maya: The librarian says we may bring one more chair. Could you check whether the doorway is clear?
Eli: Of course. I will put the chair beside the table, not in front of the door.
Maya: Thank you. I will ask the visitors what would be most useful.
Eli: That gives them a chance to explain their needs.
Maya: Yes. We can offer help without deciding everything for them.

blocks.title: The Name on the Library Card · 原创阅读
blocks.content:
阅读先用标题预测内容，再用段落中的动作、转折和结果检查预测。区分文章主旨、明确细节与推断：主旨要覆盖全文，细节可以回到原句定位，推断则需要把文本证据与合理解释连接起来。下面的短文为原创演示文章。先找主人公起初的想法，再标出促使想法变化的事件，最后解释结尾的反思怎样回扣开头。不要把一个例子扩大成所有人的共同经历。

Maya was helping at the community reading room when she found a small bag under a chair. Inside were a library card and several coins. A classmate suggested leaving it on the information desk and returning to their own work. Maya agreed that the bag should stay with the librarian, but she also asked how its owner could be contacted.

The card belonged to a visitor who used large-print books. Maya did not announce the visitor's name across the room. Instead, she gave the bag to the librarian, who used the library's normal lost-property procedure. Later that afternoon, the visitor came back and collected it.

No one gave Maya a prize. She still had shelves to tidy, and she had missed part of her break. However, she understood why the quiet procedure mattered: helping someone should also respect that person's privacy. At the end of the day, she wrote two reminders for the volunteer team: look for a useful action, and consider how that action affects the person being helped.

blocks.title: 情节与证据链
blocks.content: 文章的证据链可以画成三步：found the bag → asked about the procedure → avoided a public announcement。每一个箭头都需要用文本中的动作或话语说明，不能只凭主题名称猜测。核心细节是：Maya handed the bag to the librarian and followed the normal lost-property procedure instead of announcing the owner's name publicly. 用这条细节回答“发生了什么”，再用文章结尾回答“人物学到了什么”。若两个选项都涉及主题，应优先选择能覆盖人物起点、事件和结果的表达，而不是范围过大或只说一段内容的表达。

blocks.title: 主旨、细节与推断
blocks.content: 本文主旨是：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 这是对全文的概括；它与一条事实细节不同，也比“这是一篇关于 道德与美德 的文章”更具体。合理推断是：Maya values a respectful procedure more than public praise; the text explicitly says that she receives no prize. 推断需要证据但不是原句照抄。评价人物时先指出文本行为，再提出解释，不能因为文章主题积极就假定人物没有犹豫、没有成本或获得了奖励。

blocks.title: 有证据的复述
blocks.content:
用以下顺序做一次英文复述：人物最初的想法 → 促使想法变化的细节 → 最后的理解。复述时可使用 at first、however、by the end 等衔接语，但必须让连接词反映真实关系。下面是同主题写作拓展材料，事件与本节阅读一致，可帮助比较叙述角度；它不是阅读题的新增证据：

At first, the problem seemed simple: a visitor had left a bag under a chair. We could put it on a desk and forget about it. Maya chose to ask the librarian how lost property was handled. She wanted the owner to get it back without having personal details announced to everyone.

Her choice cost a few minutes of her break, but it protected the visitor's privacy and kept the bag in the right place. The action was quiet, and there was no reward. That is why I find the story meaningful. Responsibility is often shown through ordinary decisions.

If I faced a similar situation, I would seek a responsible adult's help and follow the agreed procedure rather than make a public display of being helpful.

最后给短文换一个标题，并用一个文本细节解释新标题为什么合适。

blocks.title: 现在分词作宾语补足语和状语
blocks.content:
本节从完整语境中观察结构，而不是只记住一个名称。先圈出例句中的目标形式，指出它修饰或补充说明的对象，再尝试改写成意思相近的完整句。对比正确句与易错句时，必须说清错误改变了哪一种语法关系；只说“读起来不顺”不能帮助修改。最后用本单元的新情境写两句自己的句子，检查意思是否清楚，再检查词形、时态和逻辑主语。

现在分词作宾语补足语时补充说明宾语正在进行的动作：I saw a reader waiting outside. 中 a reader 是 waiting 的逻辑主语。现在分词作状语时，逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致：Seeing the long queue, Maya opened another desk. 表示 Maya 先看见队伍，再采取行动。不能写成 Seeing the queue, another desk was opened，因为这样主句主语与 seeing 的执行者不一致。分词短语可以表达时间、原因或伴随关系，具体关系要由上下文确定，不能把每一个 -ing 都机械译成“正在”。

blocks.title: 结构—对象—作用
blocks.content: 语法关系图的中心句是：Seeing an older visitor waiting, Maya offered to find a seat for him. 先找句子主干，再标出目标结构及其说明的对象。可以把目标部分展开或改写，确认意思没有被改变。现在分词作宾语补足语时补充说明宾语正在进行的动作：I saw a reader waiting outside. 中 a reader 是 waiting 的逻辑主语。现在分词作状语时，逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致：Seeing the long queue, Maya opened another desk. 表示 Maya 先看见队伍，再采取行动。不能写成 Seeing the queue, another desk was opened，因为这样主句主语与 seeing 的执行者不一致。分词短语可以表达时间、原因或伴随关系，具体关系要由上下文确定，不能把每一个 -ing 都机械译成“正在”。 将“形式、依附对象、表达作用”分别放进三格，遇到新句子时按同样顺序分析，而不是只看是否出现 to 或 -ing 就直接下结论。

blocks.title: 正确句与易错句
blocks.content:
正确示例：Seeing an older visitor waiting, Maya offered to find a seat for him.
易错示例：Seeing an older visitor waiting, a seat was found by Maya.

blocks.title: 回应与追问 · 原创对话
blocks.content:
互动交流要先回应对方已经表达的意思，再补充自己的观点。复述时可以使用 So you mean ...，追问时用 Could you explain ...，表达不同看法时先说明依据。下面的对话围绕本单元具体事件展开。练习时两人交换角色：一人提出追问，一人用一个文本细节回答。避免只背一段独白而不听问题，也不要把自己的观点放进对方口中。谈话结束前用一句话确认下一步或共同理解。

Interviewer: Did you feel proud when the visitor collected the bag?
Maya: I felt relieved. I had been worried that we might make the problem worse.
Interviewer: What helped you decide what to do?
Maya: I asked the librarian instead of guessing. I also thought about the visitor's privacy.
Interviewer: Was your classmate's first suggestion unkind?
Maya: Not at all. We both wanted to help. We needed to think through the next step.
Interviewer: What will you do differently next time?
Maya: I will learn the reading room's procedures before my shift begins, so I can respond more calmly.

blocks.title: 互动中的证据路线
blocks.content: 本节互动路径不是轮流背诵，而是“听清问题 → 回应问题 → 提供依据 → 确认理解”。讨论中的可用证据是：Maya says she asked the librarian, considered the visitor's privacy and wants to learn procedures before her next shift. 可表达的理解是：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 回答追问时从证据出发；如果问题涉及文本没有说明的内容，可以说 The text does not tell us ...，然后把话题拉回已经知道的事实，保持对话真实。记录同伴追问的关键词，并检查你的回答是否正面回应了问题。

blocks.title: 理解、赞同与追问
blocks.content: 对话中的赞同、追问与不同意见应当区分。I see what you mean. 表示理解对方，不一定是完全同意；Could you explain why ...? 是索取理由，不是直接否定。把本节对话的具体意思讲清楚：Maya's answer separates kind intentions from the need to choose a respectful procedure, and she does not blame her classmate's character. 若只重复主题词 Morals and Virtues，听者仍不知道你依据了什么。语言方面还应检查：patient 作“耐心的”时常接 with：be patient with a young reader；patience 才是“耐心”这个名词。 再用一个完整句替换含混的评价。

blocks.title: 三人对话任务

小组交流任务：一位同学负责提问，一位说明自己的观点，第三位记录双方实际使用的证据。交换角色后加入一个新的追问，要求说话人解释一个限制或另一种可能。下面明确标为同主题项目拓展任务，可在本节对话结束后用于新的讨论；它不是原对话已经发生的事件：

Create a volunteer decision card for a reading room. Use three situations: a lost item, a long queue, and a visitor who cannot find a book. For each situation, write one respectful question, one practical action, and one person you can ask for help. Do not include real visitors' names or private details. Test the card with a partner acting as a new volunteer. Ask the partner to explain why the action helps and whether it could create a new problem. Revise the card so that it supports judgment rather than pretending that one slogan can solve every situation.

结束时用一句英文总结已经达成的理解，并提出仍需了解的一个问题。

blocks.title: A Small Choice in the Reading Room · 原创范文
blocks.content:
写作先确定读者和目的，再安排信息。本节的原创范文展示了主题内容如何通过具体细节展开。阅读时标出开头交代的情境、中间最重要的事件或理由，以及结尾表达的感受或判断。修改时先检查内容是否能回答写作任务，再检查段落衔接和语法。用词准确比堆砌形容词更重要；每一个评价都应有可观察的动作、对话或事实支撑，而不是连续使用 interesting、good 或 great。

At first, the problem seemed simple: a visitor had left a bag under a chair. We could put it on a desk and forget about it. Maya chose to ask the librarian how lost property was handled. She wanted the owner to get it back without having personal details announced to everyone.

Her choice cost a few minutes of her break, but it protected the visitor's privacy and kept the bag in the right place. The action was quiet, and there was no reward. That is why I find the story meaningful. Responsibility is often shown through ordinary decisions.

If I faced a similar situation, I would seek a responsible adult's help and follow the agreed procedure rather than make a public display of being helpful.

blocks.title: 段落各自承担什么作用
blocks.content: 范文可以按“情境或立场 → 关键细节 → 结果或反思”整理。它围绕 a school library and a community reading room 展开，关键内容是：Maya handed the bag to the librarian and followed the normal lost-property procedure instead of announcing the owner's name publicly. 结尾的中心意思是：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 每一段应承担不同作用，不要把结尾写成开头的简单重复。选择连接词之前先说清两句之间是时间、原因、转折还是递进关系；只有关系明确，衔接词才真正帮助读者理解。

blocks.title: 具体细节与空泛评价
blocks.content: 把空泛评价改成有细节的表达。例如只写 It was good. 没有说明为什么，而写出人物的行动和影响，读者就能判断事件的意义。当前主题可使用的具体理解是：Maya values a respectful procedure more than public praise; the text explicitly says that she receives no prize. 语法检查还应留意：看到来访者的人应与主句主语一致。以 Maya 作主语才能让 seeing 的逻辑主语清楚；被动句以 a seat 作主语会形成悬垂分词。 修改时先处理观点与事实是否一致，再检查单词形式；不要因为句子更长就认为表达一定更好。

写作任务：Write a short response to this dilemma: you promised to help prepare a class display, but a friend asks you to leave early. State the promise, describe the competing request, and propose a respectful solution. Use a participle clause only when its logical subject matches the main-clause subject. For example, Remembering my promise, I explained why I needed to stay is clear. Explain how keeping a promise differs from refusing every request for help, and add one question you would ask before deciding.

blocks.title: 自评应该检查什么
blocks.content:
自评不是重新背诵一遍单词表，而是检查能否在新情境中调动语言。先独立完成下面的纠错、释义和表达任务，再说明每一项选择的理由。把错误分成词义、搭配、句法和篇章四类，找出你真正需要复习的部分。遇到不确定的句子，回到本单元例句进行比较。能认出正确句和能自己写出正确句是两种能力；完成选择题后，还应做一次不看答案的口头或书面表达。

现在分词作宾语补足语时补充说明宾语正在进行的动作：I saw a reader waiting outside. 中 a reader 是 waiting 的逻辑主语。现在分词作状语时，逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致：Seeing the long queue, Maya opened another desk. 表示 Maya 先看见队伍，再采取行动。不能写成 Seeing the queue, another desk was opened，因为这样主句主语与 seeing 的执行者不一致。分词短语可以表达时间、原因或伴随关系，具体关系要由上下文确定，不能把每一个 -ing 都机械译成“正在”。

blocks.title: 词汇—结构—篇章
blocks.content: 把本单元整理成三层知识图：主题词汇用于谈论 道德与美德，句法结构用于表达关系，文章证据用于支撑观点。词汇示例是 responsibility 和 patient，关键搭配有 take responsibility for ... / be patient with ... / offer to help ...。结构示例是：Seeing an older visitor waiting, Maya offered to find a seat for him.。篇章核心是：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 三层之间可以互相检查，但不能用记住一个词代替理解一整段话。把一个关键词放回原句，再口头解释它与全文观点的关系。

blocks.title: 认出答案与独立表达
blocks.content:
本节自检材料：Waiting outside the reading room, the visitor saw Maya bringing an extra chair. She found the librarian checking the lost-property record.

请先解释每句意思，再判断目标结构的作用。词汇方面需辨析：patient 作“耐心的”时常接 with：be patient with a young reader；patience 才是“耐心”这个名词。 语法方面要能说明：看到来访者的人应与主句主语一致。以 Maya 作主语才能让 seeing 的逻辑主语清楚；被动句以 a seat 作主语会形成悬垂分词。 如果你只是在选项中认出了正确句，还要遮住选项重新表达一次；如果自己写错了，标出错误类型并写出一个新例句，而不是只抄一遍标准答案。

blocks.title: 项目任务书
blocks.content:
项目学习需要一个清楚的作品和可以检查的标准。本节任务不是收集越多信息越好，而是让听众理解一个主题。先确定作品用途和读者，再分配搜集、写作、校对与展示的工作；所有成员都应能解释作品的关键内容。把同伴反馈转成具体修改，例如补充一个原因、删除无依据的概括或改写不清楚的句子。展示后用一条证据说明作品改进了什么，而不是仅报告大家完成了分工。

Create a volunteer decision card for a reading room. Use three situations: a lost item, a long queue, and a visitor who cannot find a book. For each situation, write one respectful question, one practical action, and one person you can ask for help. Do not include real visitors' names or private details. Test the card with a partner acting as a new volunteer. Ask the partner to explain why the action helps and whether it could create a new problem. Revise the card so that it supports judgment rather than pretending that one slogan can solve every situation.

blocks.title: 从任务到修改
blocks.content: 项目路径为“确定问题 → 制作初稿 → 同伴测试 → 根据反馈修改”。当前作品与 a school library and a community reading room 有关，重点不是装饰，而是让读者看懂：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 可以利用的具体情境是：Maya handed the bag to the librarian and followed the normal lost-property procedure instead of announcing the owner's name publicly. 检查每一部分是否服务于作品目的，并记录一处实际修改以及修改理由。小组中每个人都应能解释一条核心信息，而不是只有写作者能够回答问题。

blocks.title: 做完与说清楚的区别
blocks.content: 任务完成与作品有效并不是同一件事。交齐资料说明完成了步骤，读者能理解并找到依据才说明表达有效。当前主题中容易过度概括的地方是：Maya values a respectful procedure more than public praise; the text explicitly says that she receives no prize. 因此展示时应分清你观察到的事实、人物的观点和小组的解释。语言检查可从这一条易错点开始：patient 作“耐心的”时常接 with：be patient with a young reader；patience 才是“耐心”这个名词。 让同伴提出一个你没有预先准备的问题，再观察作品能否帮助作答。

blocks.title: 展示、反馈与再设计
blocks.content:
展示示例材料：

At first, the problem seemed simple: a visitor had left a bag under a chair. We could put it on a desk and forget about it. Maya chose to ask the librarian how lost property was handled. She wanted the owner to get it back without having personal details announced to everyone.

Her choice cost a few minutes of her break, but it protected the visitor's privacy and kept the bag in the right place. The action was quiet, and there was no reward. That is why I find the story meaningful. Responsibility is often shown through ordinary decisions.

If I faced a similar situation, I would seek a responsible adult's help and follow the agreed procedure rather than make a public display of being helpful.

按本节项目要求改写这份材料，让它成为你的作品的一部分。注意示例只提供可观察的情境，不应冒充真实采访或真实调查。展示后收集两条具体反馈，分别说明“哪一处信息不清楚”和“怎样修改更有用”。最后用一句英文介绍你做出的一个修改，并指出它怎样帮助读者理解 道德与美德。

blocks.title: 原创短片分镜与旁白
blocks.content:
观看短片时同时关注画面、字幕和旁白。画面能显示动作与顺序，字幕可能概括主题，旁白则补充画面中看不到的原因；三者并不总是逐字重复。下面提供本地演示短片的原创分镜脚本，可在没有音频的情况下先读画面说明，再用旁白核对理解。练习时先描述你看见什么，再解释其含义，避免把自己的推测当成镜头明确展示的事实。最后用三句话复述从开头到结尾的变化。

Frame 1, 0–2 seconds: A volunteer notices a bag under a library chair. Caption: 'Notice a need.'
Frame 2, 2–4 seconds: She speaks quietly to the librarian and places the bag in the lost-property area. Caption: 'Choose a responsible action.'
Frame 3, 4–6 seconds: The owner receives the bag through the library's usual procedure. Caption: 'Help with respect.'
Voice-over: 'A kind intention is a beginning. Ask what action is useful, who should be involved, and how the other person will be affected.'

blocks.title: 三镜头叙事线
blocks.content: 三幅画面的主题路线是：发现他人需要 → 询问并选择行动 → 帮助也尊重对方。第一步交代情境，中间展示关键行动，最后揭示结果或主题。把每一幅画面能直接看到的信息写在左栏，把需要由旁白或上下文解释的意义写在右栏。可用于解释的主题句是：A helpful action should combine responsibility with respect for the person being helped. 如果镜头只给出一个例子，就不能把它扩展为关于所有人的结论；复述时用具体人物和具体动作限定范围。

blocks.title: 画面事实与意义解释
blocks.content: 观看任务要区分描述和解释。描述回答“画面展示了什么”，解释回答“这个细节为什么有意义”。当前故事的关键解释是：Maya values a respectful procedure more than public praise; the text explicitly says that she receives no prize. 若暂时关闭旁白，只依据画面能够确认哪些内容？恢复旁白后又补充了什么？用本单元词汇复述时还需注意：patient 作“耐心的”时常接 with：be patient with a young reader；patience 才是“耐心”这个名词。 保持语言与证据一致，比把每一个镜头都赋予宏大意义更准确。

blocks.title: 配音与字幕练习
blocks.content:
配音与字幕任务：两人选择本节三幅分镜，一人用三句英文描述动作，另一人用一句主题句解释它们的联系。随后交换角色，检查画面信息与评价是否分开。可以参考下面明确标出的同主题讨论拓展；其中人物的解释可帮助练习说法，但不能当作短片画面直接展示的事实：

Interviewer: Did you feel proud when the visitor collected the bag?
Maya: I felt relieved. I had been worried that we might make the problem worse.
Interviewer: What helped you decide what to do?
Maya: I asked the librarian instead of guessing. I also thought about the visitor's privacy.
Interviewer: Was your classmate's first suggestion unkind?
Maya: Not at all. We both wanted to help. We needed to think through the next step.
Interviewer: What will you do differently next time?
Maya: I will learn the reading room's procedures before my shift begins, so I can respond more calmly.

完成后让第三位同学只看字幕复述短片；如果复述与原脚本明显不同，就修改含混的主语、时间顺序或代词指向。

blocks.title: 听前定位与原创对话
blocks.content:
听力先抓场景、说话人关系与交谈目的，再记录能区分选项的细节。阅读下面的原创对话时，可以先遮住文本，由同伴朗读；第二遍再核对关键词。听到一个熟悉词并不意味着找到了答案，还要判断谁说了什么、建议是否被接受。口头回应时用完整短句说明自己的选择，并给出一个与对话一致的理由。不要把听前预测当成听后事实，也不要因为人物语气友好就推断他们已经达成了所有安排。

Sara: This soup smells different from the one I tried last week. Is it a traditional recipe?
Ben: It began with my grandmother's recipe, but we use vegetables grown near this town.
Sara: So the recipe has changed?
Ben: Yes. My family adapted it after moving here. Some ingredients were difficult to find.
Sara: May I ask your grandmother about it?
Ben: Of course, if she is free. Would you like to taste a little first?
Sara: I would love to. I will ask before taking a photograph of the stall.
Ben: Thank you. A conversation tells you more than a quick picture.

blocks.title: 信息路径：场景—建议—理由
blocks.content: 本单元听说场景是 a shared neighbourhood market。先完成信息表：人物是谁、正在解决什么问题、提出了哪些建议、最终准备怎样做。对话中的具体证据包括：Ben says his family adapted his grandmother's soup with local vegetables, and Sara plans to ask before taking a photograph. 再用它检查你记录的关键词是否属于同一件事。听力记录可以简写，但复述时要恢复完整逻辑，不要把建议写成已经发生的结果。

blocks.title: 区分听到的信息与自己的推测
blocks.content: 容易混淆的不是两个孤立单词，而是信息的确定程度。Ben treats a changing recipe as a family practice connected with a new place, and Sara chooses to ask rather than assume. 把人物的计划、解释与最终行动分别写在三栏中；如果对话只说 could 或 may，就不要在答案里改成肯定发生。语言上还需留意：culture 是名词，cultural 是形容词；写 cultural exchange，而不是把 culture exchange 当成这里的标准搭配。 用同一主题的新句子举例，比脱离语境反复抄写单词更能检查理解。

以下是同一组说话人的原创角色练习示例，保留本节场景并增加一个明确条件，不需要先阅读其他板块：
Sara: I would like to describe your soup in my class report. What should I explain first?
Ben: Please explain that it is one family's recipe, not a dish that everybody makes in the same way.
Sara: May I mention how you changed the vegetables after moving here?
Ben: Yes. That change is part of our story.
Sara: Thank you. I will check your explanation before I write my final paragraph.

blocks.title: A Market with More Than One Story · 原创阅读
blocks.content:
阅读先用标题预测内容，再用段落中的动作、转折和结果检查预测。区分文章主旨、明确细节与推断：主旨要覆盖全文，细节可以回到原句定位，推断则需要把文本证据与合理解释连接起来。下面的短文为原创演示文章。先找主人公起初的想法，再标出促使想法变化的事件，最后解释结尾的反思怎样回扣开头。不要把一个例子扩大成所有人的共同经历。

When Sara moved to a new neighbourhood, she first visited its Saturday market to buy vegetables. The stalls displayed dishes with names she did not know. She was tempted to take photographs and write that the market was a perfect picture of one culture. Then she spoke to Ben, whose family sold soup.

Ben explained that his grandmother had brought the recipe from another region. After the family settled in the town, they began using local beans because the original kind was hard to find. A neighbour suggested a different herb, and customers asked for a less salty version. The soup had a history, but it was not unchanged.

Sara visited three more stalls and heard three different stories about migration, work and friendship. In her class presentation, she did not claim that one dish represented everyone from a place. She described what she had observed and quoted the stallholders with their permission. The market helped her see cultural exchange as a continuing conversation, not a collection of fixed labels.

blocks.title: 情节与证据链
blocks.content: 文章的证据链可以画成三步：grandmother's recipe → local ingredients → neighbours' suggestions。每一个箭头都需要用文本中的动作或话语说明，不能只凭主题名称猜测。核心细节是：Ben's family adapted the soup with local beans and a neighbour's suggested herb after moving to the town. 用这条细节回答“发生了什么”，再用文章结尾回答“人物学到了什么”。若两个选项都涉及主题，应优先选择能覆盖人物起点、事件和结果的表达，而不是范围过大或只说一段内容的表达。

blocks.title: 主旨、细节与推断
blocks.content: 本文主旨是：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 这是对全文的概括；它与一条事实细节不同，也比“这是一篇关于 多样文化 的文章”更具体。合理推断是：Sara changes her presentation plan because individual stories show that the market cannot be reduced to one fixed cultural label. 推断需要证据但不是原句照抄。评价人物时先指出文本行为，再提出解释，不能因为文章主题积极就假定人物没有犹豫、没有成本或获得了奖励。

blocks.title: 有证据的复述
blocks.content:
用以下顺序做一次英文复述：人物最初的想法 → 促使想法变化的细节 → 最后的理解。复述时可使用 at first、however、by the end 等衔接语，但必须让连接词反映真实关系。下面是同主题写作拓展材料，事件与本节阅读一致，可帮助比较叙述角度；它不是阅读题的新增证据：

Our Saturday market stands beside the old station. It is small enough to walk through in ten minutes, but visitors should allow time for conversations. You can buy vegetables, try different dishes and hear how families have adapted recipes after moving here.

One stall sells a soup based on the owner's grandmother's recipe. Local beans have replaced an ingredient that was difficult to find, and a neighbour suggested the herb now used in it. This is only one family's experience, so it should not be taken as a description of an entire culture.

If you visit, ask before taking photographs and listen to the people behind the stalls. The market is interesting because its stories are still developing.

最后给短文换一个标题，并用一个文本细节解释新标题为什么合适。

blocks.title: 语境明确时的省略
blocks.content:
本节从完整语境中观察结构，而不是只记住一个名称。先圈出例句中的目标形式，指出它修饰或补充说明的对象，再尝试改写成意思相近的完整句。对比正确句与易错句时，必须说清错误改变了哪一种语法关系；只说“读起来不顺”不能帮助修改。最后用本单元的新情境写两句自己的句子，检查意思是否清楚，再检查词形、时态和逻辑主语。

省略的作用是避免重复，并让对话自然，但被省略的部分必须能由语境恢复。If possible, ask the cook about the recipe. 中 if possible 可理解为 if it is possible。对方问 Would you like to try the soup? 时，回答 I'd love to. 可以省去已经明确的 try the soup；to 往往需要保留。Want to try some? 在口语中省去 Do you，不宜直接照搬到所有正式书面语。省略不能任意删除主干成分，读者如果无法判断缺少什么，就应把句子写完整。判断省略时先恢复完整表达，再检查主谓和时态是否仍然一致。

blocks.title: 正确句与易错句

易错示例：If possibility, ask the stallholder how the recipe has changed.

省略的是 it is，不是把形容词 possible 改成名词 possibility；恢复完整形式为 If it is possible。 修改完成后还要检验主题意思有没有变化。错误句不是为了机械记忆一个禁用词，而是帮助发现词形、结构和语义之间的联系。请再写一个与 a shared neighbourhood market 相关的新例句，指出目标结构起什么作用，并用中文解释句意。

blocks.title: 回应与追问 · 原创对话
blocks.content:
互动交流要先回应对方已经表达的意思，再补充自己的观点。复述时可以使用 So you mean ...，追问时用 Could you explain ...，表达不同看法时先说明依据。下面的对话围绕本单元具体事件展开。练习时两人交换角色：一人提出追问，一人用一个文本细节回答。避免只背一段独白而不听问题，也不要把自己的观点放进对方口中。谈话结束前用一句话确认下一步或共同理解。

Guide: What surprised you at the market?
Visitor: I expected recipes to stay exactly the same. Ben explained why his family had changed theirs.
Guide: Does changing a recipe mean losing its history?
Visitor: Not necessarily. The family still knows where it came from. The changes also tell a story about their new home.
Guide: How could you describe the market fairly?
Visitor: I could describe particular conversations and say who shared each idea, instead of making claims about everyone.
Guide: Would you visit again?
Visitor: Certainly. I would like to ask how the market changes with the seasons.

blocks.title: 互动中的证据路线
blocks.content: 本节互动路径不是轮流背诵，而是“听清问题 → 回应问题 → 提供依据 → 确认理解”。讨论中的可用证据是：The visitor says a changing recipe can keep its history and plans to describe particular conversations rather than everyone. 可表达的理解是：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 回答追问时从证据出发；如果问题涉及文本没有说明的内容，可以说 The text does not tell us ...，然后把话题拉回已经知道的事实，保持对话真实。记录同伴追问的关键词，并检查你的回答是否正面回应了问题。

blocks.title: 理解、赞同与追问
blocks.content: 对话中的赞同、追问与不同意见应当区分。I see what you mean. 表示理解对方，不一定是完全同意；Could you explain why ...? 是索取理由，不是直接否定。把本节对话的具体意思讲清楚：The visitor explains that a recipe can change while keeping a known history, and specific conversations are more careful evidence than claims about everyone. 若只重复主题词 Diverse Cultures，听者仍不知道你依据了什么。语言方面还应检查：culture 是名词，cultural 是形容词；写 cultural exchange，而不是把 culture exchange 当成这里的标准搭配。 再用一个完整句替换含混的评价。

Make a neighbourhood culture map using three places you can describe from observation or from fictional interviews supplied in class. For each place, record an activity, one person's explanation, and one change over time. Separate an observation such as 'the stall sells bean soup' from an interpretation such as 'the recipe shows adaptation'. Use permission-based, anonymous quotations if you interview classmates. Add a note explaining that three examples cannot represent an entire community. Present a question for further inquiry, such as how customers have influenced the market, rather than ending with a stereotype about a group.

blocks.content:
写作先确定读者和目的，再安排信息。本节的原创范文展示了主题内容如何通过具体细节展开。阅读时标出开头交代的情境、中间最重要的事件或理由，以及结尾表达的感受或判断。修改时先检查内容是否能回答写作任务，再检查段落衔接和语法。用词准确比堆砌形容词更重要；每一个评价都应有可观察的动作、对话或事实支撑，而不是连续使用 interesting、good 或 great。

Our Saturday market stands beside the old station. It is small enough to walk through in ten minutes, but visitors should allow time for conversations. You can buy vegetables, try different dishes and hear how families have adapted recipes after moving here.

One stall sells a soup based on the owner's grandmother's recipe. Local beans have replaced an ingredient that was difficult to find, and a neighbour suggested the herb now used in it. This is only one family's experience, so it should not be taken as a description of an entire culture.

If you visit, ask before taking photographs and listen to the people behind the stalls. The market is interesting because its stories are still developing.

blocks.title: 段落各自承担什么作用
blocks.content: 范文可以按“情境或立场 → 关键细节 → 结果或反思”整理。它围绕 a shared neighbourhood market 展开，关键内容是：Ben's family adapted the soup with local beans and a neighbour's suggested herb after moving to the town. 结尾的中心意思是：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 每一段应承担不同作用，不要把结尾写成开头的简单重复。选择连接词之前先说清两句之间是时间、原因、转折还是递进关系；只有关系明确，衔接词才真正帮助读者理解。

blocks.title: 具体细节与空泛评价
blocks.content: 把空泛评价改成有细节的表达。例如只写 It was good. 没有说明为什么，而写出人物的行动和影响，读者就能判断事件的意义。当前主题可使用的具体理解是：Sara changes her presentation plan because individual stories show that the market cannot be reduced to one fixed cultural label. 语法检查还应留意：省略的是 it is，不是把形容词 possible 改成名词 possibility；恢复完整形式为 If it is possible。 修改时先处理观点与事实是否一致，再检查单词形式；不要因为句子更长就认为表达一定更好。

Add one sentence that limits your claim, for example These interviews describe three families, not every resident. Finish with a question that invites the visitor's own perspective.

blocks.title: 自评应该检查什么
blocks.content:
自评不是重新背诵一遍单词表，而是检查能否在新情境中调动语言。先独立完成下面的纠错、释义和表达任务，再说明每一项选择的理由。把错误分成词义、搭配、句法和篇章四类，找出你真正需要复习的部分。遇到不确定的句子，回到本单元例句进行比较。能认出正确句和能自己写出正确句是两种能力；完成选择题后，还应做一次不看答案的口头或书面表达。

省略的作用是避免重复，并让对话自然，但被省略的部分必须能由语境恢复。If possible, ask the cook about the recipe. 中 if possible 可理解为 if it is possible。对方问 Would you like to try the soup? 时，回答 I'd love to. 可以省去已经明确的 try the soup；to 往往需要保留。Want to try some? 在口语中省去 Do you，不宜直接照搬到所有正式书面语。省略不能任意删除主干成分，读者如果无法判断缺少什么，就应把句子写完整。判断省略时先恢复完整表达，再检查主谓和时态是否仍然一致。

blocks.title: 词汇—结构—篇章
blocks.content: 把本单元整理成三层知识图：主题词汇用于谈论 多样文化，句法结构用于表达关系，文章证据用于支撑观点。词汇示例是 diverse 和 settle，关键搭配有 settle in ... / adapt ... to ... / learn about ... through ...。结构示例是：If possible, ask the stallholder how the recipe has changed.。篇章核心是：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 三层之间可以互相检查，但不能用记住一个词代替理解一整段话。把一个关键词放回原句，再口头解释它与全文观点的关系。

blocks.title: 认出答案与独立表达
blocks.content:
本节自检材料：Would you like to hear the story? — I'd love to. If possible, we will speak to several stallholders before writing our report.

请先解释每句意思，再判断目标结构的作用。词汇方面需辨析：culture 是名词，cultural 是形容词；写 cultural exchange，而不是把 culture exchange 当成这里的标准搭配。 语法方面要能说明：省略的是 it is，不是把形容词 possible 改成名词 possibility；恢复完整形式为 If it is possible。 如果你只是在选项中认出了正确句，还要遮住选项重新表达一次；如果自己写错了，标出错误类型并写出一个新例句，而不是只抄一遍标准答案。

blocks.title: 新的语境中再表达
blocks.content:
综合输出任务：用三到四句英文说明你对 多样文化 的理解。第一句给观点，第二句给具体细节，第三句解释细节为什么支持观点；必要时再补充一个限制。可用的细节是：Ben's family adapted the soup with local beans and a neighbour's suggested herb after moving to the town.。再完成下面的原创迁移练习：

Prepare a short introduction for an exchange student's walking tour. Describe two places with specific observations and explain one change over time. Use a full sentence when the meaning would otherwise be unclear; use an elliptical response such as I'd love to only when its missing verb phrase is recoverable from the question. Add one sentence that limits your claim, for example These interviews describe three families, not every resident. Finish with a question that invites the visitor's own perspective.

自评分开记录“我能解释的内容”和“我仍需查证的表达”，据此选择下一张闪卡。

blocks.title: 项目任务书
blocks.content:
项目学习需要一个清楚的作品和可以检查的标准。本节任务不是收集越多信息越好，而是让听众理解一个主题。先确定作品用途和读者，再分配搜集、写作、校对与展示的工作；所有成员都应能解释作品的关键内容。把同伴反馈转成具体修改，例如补充一个原因、删除无依据的概括或改写不清楚的句子。展示后用一条证据说明作品改进了什么，而不是仅报告大家完成了分工。

Make a neighbourhood culture map using three places you can describe from observation or from fictional interviews supplied in class. For each place, record an activity, one person's explanation, and one change over time. Separate an observation such as 'the stall sells bean soup' from an interpretation such as 'the recipe shows adaptation'. Use permission-based, anonymous quotations if you interview classmates. Add a note explaining that three examples cannot represent an entire community. Present a question for further inquiry, such as how customers have influenced the market, rather than ending with a stereotype about a group.

blocks.title: 从任务到修改
blocks.content: 项目路径为“确定问题 → 制作初稿 → 同伴测试 → 根据反馈修改”。当前作品与 a shared neighbourhood market 有关，重点不是装饰，而是让读者看懂：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 可以利用的具体情境是：Ben's family adapted the soup with local beans and a neighbour's suggested herb after moving to the town. 检查每一部分是否服务于作品目的，并记录一处实际修改以及修改理由。小组中每个人都应能解释一条核心信息，而不是只有写作者能够回答问题。

blocks.title: 做完与说清楚的区别
blocks.content: 任务完成与作品有效并不是同一件事。交齐资料说明完成了步骤，读者能理解并找到依据才说明表达有效。当前主题中容易过度概括的地方是：Sara changes her presentation plan because individual stories show that the market cannot be reduced to one fixed cultural label. 因此展示时应分清你观察到的事实、人物的观点和小组的解释。语言检查可从这一条易错点开始：culture 是名词，cultural 是形容词；写 cultural exchange，而不是把 culture exchange 当成这里的标准搭配。 让同伴提出一个你没有预先准备的问题，再观察作品能否帮助作答。

blocks.title: 展示、反馈与再设计
blocks.content:
展示示例材料：

Our Saturday market stands beside the old station. It is small enough to walk through in ten minutes, but visitors should allow time for conversations. You can buy vegetables, try different dishes and hear how families have adapted recipes after moving here.

One stall sells a soup based on the owner's grandmother's recipe. Local beans have replaced an ingredient that was difficult to find, and a neighbour suggested the herb now used in it. This is only one family's experience, so it should not be taken as a description of an entire culture.

If you visit, ask before taking photographs and listen to the people behind the stalls. The market is interesting because its stories are still developing.

按本节项目要求改写这份材料，让它成为你的作品的一部分。注意示例只提供可观察的情境，不应冒充真实采访或真实调查。展示后收集两条具体反馈，分别说明“哪一处信息不清楚”和“怎样修改更有用”。最后用一句英文介绍你做出的一个修改，并指出它怎样帮助读者理解 多样文化。

blocks.title: 原创短片分镜与旁白
blocks.content:
观看短片时同时关注画面、字幕和旁白。画面能显示动作与顺序，字幕可能概括主题，旁白则补充画面中看不到的原因；三者并不总是逐字重复。下面提供本地演示短片的原创分镜脚本，可在没有音频的情况下先读画面说明，再用旁白核对理解。练习时先描述你看见什么，再解释其含义，避免把自己的推测当成镜头明确展示的事实。最后用三句话复述从开头到结尾的变化。

Frame 1, 0–2 seconds: A recipe card sits beside ingredients from a new town. Caption: 'A recipe has a history.'
Frame 2, 2–4 seconds: A cook replaces one ingredient and talks with a neighbour. Caption: 'Everyday exchange brings change.'
Frame 3, 4–6 seconds: Visitors listen to several stallholders instead of placing one label on the whole market. Caption: 'Listen to more than one story.'
Voice-over: 'Culture is shared, but people do not all have the same experience. Describe specific voices and notice how practices develop.'

blocks.title: 三镜头叙事线
blocks.content: 三幅画面的主题路线是：了解原有故事 → 观察交流与改变 → 避免单一标签。第一步交代情境，中间展示关键行动，最后揭示结果或主题。把每一幅画面能直接看到的信息写在左栏，把需要由旁白或上下文解释的意义写在右栏。可用于解释的主题句是：Cultural practices can keep their history while changing through migration and everyday exchange. 如果镜头只给出一个例子，就不能把它扩展为关于所有人的结论；复述时用具体人物和具体动作限定范围。

blocks.title: 画面事实与意义解释
blocks.content: 观看任务要区分描述和解释。描述回答“画面展示了什么”，解释回答“这个细节为什么有意义”。当前故事的关键解释是：Sara changes her presentation plan because individual stories show that the market cannot be reduced to one fixed cultural label. 若暂时关闭旁白，只依据画面能够确认哪些内容？恢复旁白后又补充了什么？用本单元词汇复述时还需注意：culture 是名词，cultural 是形容词；写 cultural exchange，而不是把 culture exchange 当成这里的标准搭配。 保持语言与证据一致，比把每一个镜头都赋予宏大意义更准确。

blocks.title: 配音与字幕练习
blocks.content:
配音与字幕任务：两人选择本节三幅分镜，一人用三句英文描述动作，另一人用一句主题句解释它们的联系。随后交换角色，检查画面信息与评价是否分开。可以参考下面明确标出的同主题讨论拓展；其中人物的解释可帮助练习说法，但不能当作短片画面直接展示的事实：

Guide: What surprised you at the market?
Visitor: I expected recipes to stay exactly the same. Ben explained why his family had changed theirs.
Guide: Does changing a recipe mean losing its history?
Visitor: Not necessarily. The family still knows where it came from. The changes also tell a story about their new home.
Guide: How could you describe the market fairly?
Visitor: I could describe particular conversations and say who shared each idea, instead of making claims about everyone.
Guide: Would you visit again?
Visitor: Certainly. I would like to ask how the market changes with the seasons.

完成后让第三位同学只看字幕复述短片；如果复述与原脚本明显不同，就修改含混的主语、时间顺序或代词指向。

blocks.title: 听前定位与原创对话
blocks.content:
听力先抓场景、说话人关系与交谈目的，再记录能区分选项的细节。阅读下面的原创对话时，可以先遮住文本，由同伴朗读；第二遍再核对关键词。听到一个熟悉词并不意味着找到了答案，还要判断谁说了什么、建议是否被接受。口头回应时用完整短句说明自己的选择，并给出一个与对话一致的理由。不要把听前预测当成听后事实，也不要因为人物语气友好就推断他们已经达成了所有安排。

Leo: Our class satellite needs a clear mission. What should it observe?
Ava: We could design it to compare cloud cover over the same area at different times.
Leo: Then do we choose the camera first?
Ava: We should discuss the question and the data we need before choosing equipment.
Leo: What about power?
Ava: The model must show how the instruments receive energy and how stored energy is used when light is unavailable.
Leo: We cannot test it in space.
Ava: True. We can explain the limits of our classroom model and test one part of the design on the ground.

blocks.title: 信息路径：场景—建议—理由
blocks.content: 本单元听说场景是 a school satellite-design discussion。先完成信息表：人物是谁、正在解决什么问题、提出了哪些建议、最终准备怎样做。对话中的具体证据包括：The team will define its cloud-cover question and required data before choosing equipment. 再用它检查你记录的关键词是否属于同一件事。听力记录可以简写，但复述时要恢复完整逻辑，不要把建议写成已经发生的结果。

blocks.title: 区分听到的信息与自己的推测
blocks.content: 容易混淆的不是两个孤立单词，而是信息的确定程度。Ava prioritises a question and the data it requires over an impressive list of equipment; the class design remains a model. 把人物的计划、解释与最终行动分别写在三栏中；如果对话只说 could 或 may，就不要在答案里改成肯定发生。语言上还需留意：evidence 通常作不可数名词；写 collect evidence 或 a piece of evidence，不写 an evidence 来表示一条证据。 用同一主题的新句子举例，比脱离语境反复抄写单词更能检查理解。

blocks.title: 双人角色任务
blocks.content:
角色任务：两人重组关于 a school satellite-design discussion 的对话。一人保留原来的目标，另一人更换一个条件，例如时间、参与者或可用材料；先提出一个清楚的问题，再给出有理由的回应。可参考的表达是：The team tested the power system to find possible faults.

以下是同一组说话人的原创角色练习示例，保留本节场景并增加一个明确条件，不需要先阅读其他板块：
Leo: If our model could answer only one question, which question would we choose?
Ava: We would compare cloud cover over the same area at different times.
Leo: Then we need images that can be compared.
Ava: Exactly. The camera has a purpose because of the data we need.
Leo: I will also label the battery.
Ava: Good. Explain its intended function, and say that the drawing is not a real-space test.

blocks.title: A Mission Small Enough to Explain · 原创阅读
blocks.content:
阅读先用标题预测内容，再用段落中的动作、转折和结果检查预测。区分文章主旨、明确细节与推断：主旨要覆盖全文，细节可以回到原句定位，推断则需要把文本证据与合理解释连接起来。下面的短文为原创演示文章。先找主人公起初的想法，再标出促使想法变化的事件，最后解释结尾的反思怎样回扣开头。不要把一个例子扩大成所有人的共同经历。

Leo's class was asked to design a model satellite, not to launch one. At first, the group drew a large spacecraft covered with instruments. Their teacher asked a simple question: what evidence would those instruments collect? The group could not give a clear answer.

They began again with a smaller mission: compare cloud cover over one area at different times. This question helped them decide what kind of images they would need. They also added a power diagram showing a solar panel, a battery and the instruments. The battery mattered because the instruments might need energy when direct light was unavailable.

During the presentation, Leo explained what the classroom model could and could not show. It could make the mission and energy pathway visible, but it could not prove that real equipment would survive in orbit. The class preferred the second design because each part had a reason to be there. Leo learned that a useful scientific proposal starts with a question and a plan for evidence, not simply with impressive-looking technology.

blocks.title: 情节与证据链
blocks.content: 文章的证据链可以画成三步：unclear instrument list → cloud-cover question → power diagram → limits of the model。每一个箭头都需要用文本中的动作或话语说明，不能只凭主题名称猜测。核心细节是：The group chose to compare cloud cover over one area at different times and included a battery for times when direct light was unavailable. 用这条细节回答“发生了什么”，再用文章结尾回答“人物学到了什么”。若两个选项都涉及主题，应优先选择能覆盖人物起点、事件和结果的表达，而不是范围过大或只说一段内容的表达。

blocks.title: 主旨、细节与推断
blocks.content: 本文主旨是：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 这是对全文的概括；它与一条事实细节不同，也比“这是一篇关于 太空探索 的文章”更具体。合理推断是：The second design is clearer because its parts answer a defined question; the text does not claim that fewer instruments are always better for real missions. 推断需要证据但不是原句照抄。评价人物时先指出文本行为，再提出解释，不能因为文章主题积极就假定人物没有犹豫、没有成本或获得了奖励。

blocks.title: 有证据的复述
blocks.content:
用以下顺序做一次英文复述：人物最初的想法 → 促使想法变化的细节 → 最后的理解。复述时可使用 at first、however、by the end 等衔接语，但必须让连接词反映真实关系。下面是同主题写作拓展材料，事件与本节阅读一致，可帮助比较叙述角度；它不是阅读题的新增证据：

Our model satellite is designed to compare cloud cover over one area at different times. We chose this mission because it gives us a question that every part of the model can help explain. A camera represents the instrument used to collect images, while the power diagram shows a solar panel and a battery.

The model is useful for communication. It helps our audience follow the link between a question, the required data and the equipment. However, a classroom model cannot show that the equipment would survive a real launch or operate reliably in orbit.

For this reason, we describe our work as a design explanation. We will improve it by asking classmates whether the energy pathway and the limits are easy to understand.

最后给短文换一个标题，并用一个文本细节解释新标题为什么合适。

blocks.title: 不定式作定语和目的状语
blocks.content:
本节从完整语境中观察结构，而不是只记住一个名称。先圈出例句中的目标形式，指出它修饰或补充说明的对象，再尝试改写成意思相近的完整句。对比正确句与易错句时，必须说清错误改变了哪一种语法关系；只说“读起来不顺”不能帮助修改。最后用本单元的新情境写两句自己的句子，检查意思是否清楚，再检查词形、时态和逻辑主语。

不定式可以作后置定语，说明名词的用途、任务或有待完成的动作：a satellite to observe clouds 表示用于观测云层的卫星，a problem to solve 表示需要解决的问题。它也可作目的状语：The team repeated the test to improve reliability. 中 to improve 回答重复测试的目的。不要把目的与已实现的结果混为一谈，designed to observe 说明设计目标，不等于已经获得数据。first、last 或序数词修饰名词时也常用不定式，如 the first student to notice the fault。解释句子时先判断不定式修饰哪个词，再判断它表达用途还是目的。

blocks.title: 结构—对象—作用
blocks.content: 语法关系图的中心句是：The team tested the power system to find possible faults. 先找句子主干，再标出目标结构及其说明的对象。可以把目标部分展开或改写，确认意思没有被改变。不定式可以作后置定语，说明名词的用途、任务或有待完成的动作：a satellite to observe clouds 表示用于观测云层的卫星，a problem to solve 表示需要解决的问题。它也可作目的状语：The team repeated the test to improve reliability. 中 to improve 回答重复测试的目的。不要把目的与已实现的结果混为一谈，designed to observe 说明设计目标，不等于已经获得数据。first、last 或序数词修饰名词时也常用不定式，如 the first student to notice the fault。解释句子时先判断不定式修饰哪个词，再判断它表达用途还是目的。 将“形式、依附对象、表达作用”分别放进三格，遇到新句子时按同样顺序分析，而不是只看是否出现 to 或 -ing 就直接下结论。

blocks.title: 正确句与易错句
blocks.content:
正确示例：The team tested the power system to find possible faults.
易错示例：The team tested the power system for find possible faults.

表达“为了发现问题”的目的时用 to find。介词 for 后不能直接接动词原形 find，另一种结构可写 for finding，但本句目的状语用不定式更直接。 修改完成后还要检验主题意思有没有变化。错误句不是为了机械记忆一个禁用词，而是帮助发现词形、结构和语义之间的联系。请再写一个与 a school satellite-design discussion 相关的新例句，指出目标结构起什么作用，并用中文解释句意。

blocks.title: 放进新的主题情境
blocks.content:
迁移任务：阅读下面的原创情境，然后用本节结构写两句补充说明。第一句描述人物、物品或行为，第二句说明理由、目的或说话人的立场；具体用途以本节语法为准。写好后交换检查，先指出逻辑关系，再提出修改。下面是同主题应用对话，作为原创拓展情境，不是本节语法题所依赖的额外前文：

Presenter: Our satellite model is designed to compare cloud cover.
Audience: Why did you remove some of the instruments from your first drawing?
Presenter: They did not help answer our question. We wanted each part to have a clear purpose.
Audience: What is the battery for?
Presenter: It represents stored energy for times when direct light is unavailable.
Audience: Does the model prove that the satellite would work in orbit?
Presenter: No. It explains a design. Real operation would require many tests that our classroom activity cannot provide.
Audience: What will you improve next?
Presenter: We will make the link between the mission and the required images clearer.

参考句：The team tested the power system to find possible faults. 如果你的新句子与这个例句结构不同，应说明差别，而不必强行把所有句子改成同一种形式。

blocks.title: 回应与追问 · 原创对话
blocks.content:
互动交流要先回应对方已经表达的意思，再补充自己的观点。复述时可以使用 So you mean ...，追问时用 Could you explain ...，表达不同看法时先说明依据。下面的对话围绕本单元具体事件展开。练习时两人交换角色：一人提出追问，一人用一个文本细节回答。避免只背一段独白而不听问题，也不要把自己的观点放进对方口中。谈话结束前用一句话确认下一步或共同理解。

Presenter: Our satellite model is designed to compare cloud cover.
Audience: Why did you remove some of the instruments from your first drawing?
Presenter: They did not help answer our question. We wanted each part to have a clear purpose.
Audience: What is the battery for?
Presenter: It represents stored energy for times when direct light is unavailable.
Audience: Does the model prove that the satellite would work in orbit?
Presenter: No. It explains a design. Real operation would require many tests that our classroom activity cannot provide.
Audience: What will you improve next?
Presenter: We will make the link between the mission and the required images clearer.

blocks.title: 互动中的证据路线
blocks.content: 本节互动路径不是轮流背诵，而是“听清问题 → 回应问题 → 提供依据 → 确认理解”。讨论中的可用证据是：The presenter explains that the battery represents stored energy and the classroom model does not prove real operation in orbit. 可表达的理解是：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 回答追问时从证据出发；如果问题涉及文本没有说明的内容，可以说 The text does not tell us ...，然后把话题拉回已经知道的事实，保持对话真实。记录同伴追问的关键词，并检查你的回答是否正面回应了问题。

blocks.title: 理解、赞同与追问
blocks.content: 对话中的赞同、追问与不同意见应当区分。I see what you mean. 表示理解对方，不一定是完全同意；Could you explain why ...? 是索取理由，不是直接否定。把本节对话的具体意思讲清楚：The presenter distinguishes the battery's intended function from proof that real equipment will operate in orbit. 若只重复主题词 Space Exploration，听者仍不知道你依据了什么。语言方面还应检查：evidence 通常作不可数名词；写 collect evidence 或 a piece of evidence，不写 an evidence 来表示一条证据。 再用一个完整句替换含混的评价。

blocks.title: 三人对话任务
blocks.content:
小组交流任务：一位同学负责提问，一位说明自己的观点，第三位记录双方实际使用的证据。交换角色后加入一个新的追问，要求说话人解释一个限制或另一种可能。下面明确标为同主题项目拓展任务，可在本节对话结束后用于新的讨论；它不是原对话已经发生的事件：

Create a mission board for a fictional observation satellite. Give it one research question, list the data needed to answer that question, and draw an energy pathway from a source through storage to an instrument. Write a 90-second explanation using infinitives of purpose, such as We include a battery to store energy. Ask another group to identify any component whose purpose is unclear. Add two limitations of the classroom model. This is a paper design and communication task; it does not involve building or launching a flying device. Revise the board until the scientific question is more prominent than the decoration.

结束时用一句英文总结已经达成的理解，并提出仍需了解的一个问题。

blocks.title: Why Our Model Needs a Clear Mission · 原创范文
blocks.content:
写作先确定读者和目的，再安排信息。本节的原创范文展示了主题内容如何通过具体细节展开。阅读时标出开头交代的情境、中间最重要的事件或理由，以及结尾表达的感受或判断。修改时先检查内容是否能回答写作任务，再检查段落衔接和语法。用词准确比堆砌形容词更重要；每一个评价都应有可观察的动作、对话或事实支撑，而不是连续使用 interesting、good 或 great。

Our model satellite is designed to compare cloud cover over one area at different times. We chose this mission because it gives us a question that every part of the model can help explain. A camera represents the instrument used to collect images, while the power diagram shows a solar panel and a battery.

The model is useful for communication. It helps our audience follow the link between a question, the required data and the equipment. However, a classroom model cannot show that the equipment would survive a real launch or operate reliably in orbit.

For this reason, we describe our work as a design explanation. We will improve it by asking classmates whether the energy pathway and the limits are easy to understand.

blocks.title: 段落各自承担什么作用
blocks.content: 范文可以按“情境或立场 → 关键细节 → 结果或反思”整理。它围绕 a school satellite-design discussion 展开，关键内容是：The group chose to compare cloud cover over one area at different times and included a battery for times when direct light was unavailable. 结尾的中心意思是：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 每一段应承担不同作用，不要把结尾写成开头的简单重复。选择连接词之前先说清两句之间是时间、原因、转折还是递进关系；只有关系明确，衔接词才真正帮助读者理解。

blocks.title: 具体细节与空泛评价
blocks.content: 把空泛评价改成有细节的表达。例如只写 It was good. 没有说明为什么，而写出人物的行动和影响，读者就能判断事件的意义。当前主题可使用的具体理解是：The second design is clearer because its parts answer a defined question; the text does not claim that fewer instruments are always better for real missions. 语法检查还应留意：表达“为了发现问题”的目的时用 to find。介词 for 后不能直接接动词原形 find，另一种结构可写 for finding，但本句目的状语用不定式更直接。 修改时先处理观点与事实是否一致，再检查单词形式；不要因为句子更长就认为表达一定更好。

blocks.title: 自评应该检查什么
blocks.content:
自评不是重新背诵一遍单词表，而是检查能否在新情境中调动语言。先独立完成下面的纠错、释义和表达任务，再说明每一项选择的理由。把错误分成词义、搭配、句法和篇章四类，找出你真正需要复习的部分。遇到不确定的句子，回到本单元例句进行比较。能认出正确句和能自己写出正确句是两种能力；完成选择题后，还应做一次不看答案的口头或书面表达。

不定式可以作后置定语，说明名词的用途、任务或有待完成的动作：a satellite to observe clouds 表示用于观测云层的卫星，a problem to solve 表示需要解决的问题。它也可作目的状语：The team repeated the test to improve reliability. 中 to improve 回答重复测试的目的。不要把目的与已实现的结果混为一谈，designed to observe 说明设计目标，不等于已经获得数据。first、last 或序数词修饰名词时也常用不定式，如 the first student to notice the fault。解释句子时先判断不定式修饰哪个词，再判断它表达用途还是目的。

blocks.title: 词汇—结构—篇章
blocks.content: 把本单元整理成三层知识图：主题词汇用于谈论 太空探索，句法结构用于表达关系，文章证据用于支撑观点。词汇示例是 explore 和 orbit，关键搭配有 in orbit / be designed to ... / collect data on ...。结构示例是：The team tested the power system to find possible faults.。篇章核心是：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 三层之间可以互相检查，但不能用记住一个词代替理解一整段话。把一个关键词放回原句，再口头解释它与全文观点的关系。

blocks.content:
本节自检材料：The first student to notice the fault asked for another test. The team drew a diagram to explain how the battery supplied the instrument.

请先解释每句意思，再判断目标结构的作用。词汇方面需辨析：evidence 通常作不可数名词；写 collect evidence 或 a piece of evidence，不写 an evidence 来表示一条证据。 语法方面要能说明：表达“为了发现问题”的目的时用 to find。介词 for 后不能直接接动词原形 find，另一种结构可写 for finding，但本句目的状语用不定式更直接。 如果你只是在选项中认出了正确句，还要遮住选项重新表达一次；如果自己写错了，标出错误类型并写出一个新例句，而不是只抄一遍标准答案。

综合输出任务：用三到四句英文说明你对 太空探索 的理解。第一句给观点，第二句给具体细节，第三句解释细节为什么支持观点；必要时再补充一个限制。可用的细节是：The group chose to compare cloud cover over one area at different times and included a battery for times when direct light was unavailable.。再完成下面的原创迁移练习：

blocks.title: 项目任务书
blocks.content:
项目学习需要一个清楚的作品和可以检查的标准。本节任务不是收集越多信息越好，而是让听众理解一个主题。先确定作品用途和读者，再分配搜集、写作、校对与展示的工作；所有成员都应能解释作品的关键内容。把同伴反馈转成具体修改，例如补充一个原因、删除无依据的概括或改写不清楚的句子。展示后用一条证据说明作品改进了什么，而不是仅报告大家完成了分工。

Create a mission board for a fictional observation satellite. Give it one research question, list the data needed to answer that question, and draw an energy pathway from a source through storage to an instrument. Write a 90-second explanation using infinitives of purpose, such as We include a battery to store energy. Ask another group to identify any component whose purpose is unclear. Add two limitations of the classroom model. This is a paper design and communication task; it does not involve building or launching a flying device. Revise the board until the scientific question is more prominent than the decoration.

blocks.title: 从任务到修改
blocks.content: 项目路径为“确定问题 → 制作初稿 → 同伴测试 → 根据反馈修改”。当前作品与 a school satellite-design discussion 有关，重点不是装饰，而是让读者看懂：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 可以利用的具体情境是：The group chose to compare cloud cover over one area at different times and included a battery for times when direct light was unavailable. 检查每一部分是否服务于作品目的，并记录一处实际修改以及修改理由。小组中每个人都应能解释一条核心信息，而不是只有写作者能够回答问题。

blocks.title: 做完与说清楚的区别
blocks.content: 任务完成与作品有效并不是同一件事。交齐资料说明完成了步骤，读者能理解并找到依据才说明表达有效。当前主题中容易过度概括的地方是：The second design is clearer because its parts answer a defined question; the text does not claim that fewer instruments are always better for real missions. 因此展示时应分清你观察到的事实、人物的观点和小组的解释。语言检查可从这一条易错点开始：evidence 通常作不可数名词；写 collect evidence 或 a piece of evidence，不写 an evidence 来表示一条证据。 让同伴提出一个你没有预先准备的问题，再观察作品能否帮助作答。

The model is useful for communication. It helps our audience follow the link between a question, the required data and the equipment. However, a classroom model cannot show that the equipment would survive a real launch or operate reliably in orbit.

For this reason, we describe our work as a design explanation. We will improve it by asking classmates whether the energy pathway and the limits are easy to understand.

blocks.title: 原创短片分镜与旁白
blocks.content:
观看短片时同时关注画面、字幕和旁白。画面能显示动作与顺序，字幕可能概括主题，旁白则补充画面中看不到的原因；三者并不总是逐字重复。下面提供本地演示短片的原创分镜脚本，可在没有音频的情况下先读画面说明，再用旁白核对理解。练习时先描述你看见什么，再解释其含义，避免把自己的推测当成镜头明确展示的事实。最后用三句话复述从开头到结尾的变化。

Frame 1, 0–2 seconds: A question appears above a sketch of clouds. Caption: 'What do we want to find out?'
Frame 2, 2–4 seconds: Arrows connect a camera, collected images and the question. Caption: 'Choose evidence before equipment.'
Frame 3, 4–6 seconds: A solar panel, battery and instrument form an energy pathway. Caption: 'Explain functions and limits.'
Voice-over: 'A model helps us explain a mission. It does not replace the tests required for real equipment in space. Start with a question, and give each component a purpose.'

blocks.title: 三镜头叙事线
blocks.content: 三幅画面的主题路线是：提出观测问题 → 确定证据和仪器 → 解释能源与模型局限。第一步交代情境，中间展示关键行动，最后揭示结果或主题。把每一幅画面能直接看到的信息写在左栏，把需要由旁白或上下文解释的意义写在右栏。可用于解释的主题句是：A clear scientific question should guide the choice of instruments, tests and claims in a model mission. 如果镜头只给出一个例子，就不能把它扩展为关于所有人的结论；复述时用具体人物和具体动作限定范围。

blocks.title: 画面事实与意义解释
blocks.content: 观看任务要区分描述和解释。描述回答“画面展示了什么”，解释回答“这个细节为什么有意义”。当前故事的关键解释是：The second design is clearer because its parts answer a defined question; the text does not claim that fewer instruments are always better for real missions. 若暂时关闭旁白，只依据画面能够确认哪些内容？恢复旁白后又补充了什么？用本单元词汇复述时还需注意：evidence 通常作不可数名词；写 collect evidence 或 a piece of evidence，不写 an evidence 来表示一条证据。 保持语言与证据一致，比把每一个镜头都赋予宏大意义更准确。

blocks.title: 配音与字幕练习
blocks.content:
配音与字幕任务：两人选择本节三幅分镜，一人用三句英文描述动作，另一人用一句主题句解释它们的联系。随后交换角色，检查画面信息与评价是否分开。可以参考下面明确标出的同主题讨论拓展；其中人物的解释可帮助练习说法，但不能当作短片画面直接展示的事实：

Presenter: Our satellite model is designed to compare cloud cover.
Audience: Why did you remove some of the instruments from your first drawing?
Presenter: They did not help answer our question. We wanted each part to have a clear purpose.
Audience: What is the battery for?
Presenter: It represents stored energy for times when direct light is unavailable.
Audience: Does the model prove that the satellite would work in orbit?
Presenter: No. It explains a design. Real operation would require many tests that our classroom activity cannot provide.
Audience: What will you improve next?
Presenter: We will make the link between the mission and the required images clearer.

完成后让第三位同学只看字幕复述短片；如果复述与原脚本明显不同，就修改含混的主语、时间顺序或代词指向。

blocks.title: 听前定位与原创对话
blocks.content:
听力先抓场景、说话人关系与交谈目的，再记录能区分选项的细节。阅读下面的原创对话时，可以先遮住文本，由同伴朗读；第二遍再核对关键词。听到一个熟悉词并不意味着找到了答案，还要判断谁说了什么、建议是否被接受。口头回应时用完整短句说明自己的选择，并给出一个与对话一致的理由。不要把听前预测当成听后事实，也不要因为人物语气友好就推断他们已经达成了所有安排。

Sam: My bag is torn, but I cannot afford to replace it this week.
Nora: The repair corner may be able to help. You should ask what can be repaired before buying another one.
Sam: Do they charge for everything?
Nora: They explain the options first. Sometimes a small repair needs only a few minutes.
Sam: I do not know how to sew.
Nora: You can still contribute. Last month I helped organise the tools in return for a lesson.
Sam: Then I will ask whether they need help setting up.
Nora: Good. Money pays for some things, but time, skills and trust also have value.

blocks.title: 信息路径：场景—建议—理由
blocks.content: 本单元听说场景是 a neighbourhood repair corner。先完成信息表：人物是谁、正在解决什么问题、提出了哪些建议、最终准备怎样做。对话中的具体证据包括：Nora suggests asking about repair options first, and Sam plans to offer help setting up. 再用它检查你记录的关键词是否属于同一件事。听力记录可以简写，但复述时要恢复完整逻辑，不要把建议写成已经发生的结果。

blocks.title: 区分听到的信息与自己的推测
blocks.content: 容易混淆的不是两个孤立单词，而是信息的确定程度。Nora presents repair as an option to investigate, and Sam offers useful help rather than claiming that all repairs have no cost. 把人物的计划、解释与最终行动分别写在三栏中；如果对话只说 could 或 may，就不要在答案里改成肯定发生。语言上还需留意：afford 后常接名词或 to do：cannot afford a new bag / cannot afford to replace it；不要写 afford replacing it 作为这里的标准表达。 用同一主题的新句子举例，比脱离语境反复抄写单词更能检查理解。

以下是同一组说话人的原创角色练习示例，保留本节场景并增加一个明确条件，不需要先阅读其他板块：
Sam: I have asked about the repair. They can explain the materials on Saturday.
Nora: Then you can decide whether the option suits your needs.
Sam: I have also offered to help arrange the tables.
Nora: That sounds useful. Please ask where the tools should go before moving them.
Sam: I will. I want to learn a skill and keep my promise to help.
Nora: Both of those can contribute to the afternoon.

blocks.title: A Bag, a Promise and a Useful Skill · 原创阅读
blocks.content:
阅读先用标题预测内容，再用段落中的动作、转折和结果检查预测。区分文章主旨、明确细节与推断：主旨要覆盖全文，细节可以回到原句定位，推断则需要把文本证据与合理解释连接起来。下面的短文为原创演示文章。先找主人公起初的想法，再标出促使想法变化的事件，最后解释结尾的反思怎样回扣开头。不要把一个例子扩大成所有人的共同经历。

Sam brought a torn bag to the neighbourhood repair corner because he could not afford a new one that week. He expected a quick repair and a price. Instead, Nora asked how the bag had been damaged and whether he wanted to learn a simple way to mend it.

Nora said she would repair the handle on Saturday if Sam could help arrange the tools before the session. She did not pretend that every broken object could be saved. She explained the weak part of the handle and showed him how to check it after the repair. Sam listened patiently, then helped another visitor find the right table.

By the end of the session, he had a usable bag and one new skill. He also understood that the corner depended on people keeping their promises. His help had not replaced all the materials or expertise needed for the repair, but it had contributed to a shared activity. In his school reflection, Sam wrote that money was important without being the only measure of value. Time, knowledge and trust made the afternoon work as well.

blocks.title: 情节与证据链
blocks.content: 文章的证据链可以画成三步：could not afford a new bag → offered help → learned a skill → reflected on trust。每一个箭头都需要用文本中的动作或话语说明，不能只凭主题名称猜测。核心细节是：Nora promised to repair the handle on Saturday, and Sam helped arrange the tools before the session. 用这条细节回答“发生了什么”，再用文章结尾回答“人物学到了什么”。若两个选项都涉及主题，应优先选择能覆盖人物起点、事件和结果的表达，而不是范围过大或只说一段内容的表达。

blocks.title: 主旨、细节与推断
blocks.content: 本文主旨是：Money matters, but shared time, useful skills and reliable promises can create value as well. 这是对全文的概括；它与一条事实细节不同，也比“这是一篇关于 金钱的价值 的文章”更具体。合理推断是：Sam's contribution matters without making the repair free of all costs; the story mentions both materials and expertise. 推断需要证据但不是原句照抄。评价人物时先指出文本行为，再提出解释，不能因为文章主题积极就假定人物没有犹豫、没有成本或获得了奖励。

blocks.title: 有证据的复述
blocks.content:
用以下顺序做一次英文复述：人物最初的想法 → 促使想法变化的细节 → 最后的理解。复述时可使用 at first、however、by the end 等衔接语，但必须让连接词反映真实关系。下面是同主题写作拓展材料，事件与本节阅读一致，可帮助比较叙述角度；它不是阅读题的新增证据：

Scene: A table in the community room. A torn bag lies between Sam and Nora.

Sam: I thought I had to buy a new one.
Nora: You may have another option. This handle can be repaired, but it will still need careful use.
Sam: I cannot pay much today.
Nora: Let us discuss the materials first. You could also help arrange the tools before Saturday's session.
Sam: I can do that. Will you show me what to check afterwards?
Nora: Certainly. A repair is more useful when you understand it.

Sam picks up a list of tools. He places the bag beside the list rather than throwing it away. The scene ends with a plan that both characters can explain.

最后给短文换一个标题，并用一个文本细节解释新标题为什么合适。

blocks.title: 情态动词与过去将来时
blocks.content:
本节从完整语境中观察结构，而不是只记住一个名称。先圈出例句中的目标形式，指出它修饰或补充说明的对象，再尝试改写成意思相近的完整句。对比正确句与易错句时，必须说清错误改变了哪一种语法关系；只说“读起来不顺”不能帮助修改。最后用本单元的新情境写两句自己的句子，检查意思是否清楚，再检查词形、时态和逻辑主语。

情态动词要结合语境解释：may 可以表示不确定的可能性，should 常用于建议或应该承担的责任，must 可以表达强烈要求，也可以基于证据作较有把握的推测。不要把 may 一律译成“允许”，也不要把 must 一律当作命令。过去将来时常从过去的时间点谈之后的安排：Nora said she would repair the bag on Saturday. would repair 表示她当时说到的后续行动，不自动保证后来真的完成。写故事时应区分人物的计划、推测和已经发生的事件，必要时再用一般过去时交代结果。

blocks.title: 结构—对象—作用
blocks.content: 语法关系图的中心句是：Nora said she would repair the bag on Saturday, and she kept her promise. 先找句子主干，再标出目标结构及其说明的对象。可以把目标部分展开或改写，确认意思没有被改变。情态动词要结合语境解释：may 可以表示不确定的可能性，should 常用于建议或应该承担的责任，must 可以表达强烈要求，也可以基于证据作较有把握的推测。不要把 may 一律译成“允许”，也不要把 must 一律当作命令。过去将来时常从过去的时间点谈之后的安排：Nora said she would repair the bag on Saturday. would repair 表示她当时说到的后续行动，不自动保证后来真的完成。写故事时应区分人物的计划、推测和已经发生的事件，必要时再用一般过去时交代结果。 将“形式、依附对象、表达作用”分别放进三格，遇到新句子时按同样顺序分析，而不是只看是否出现 to 或 -ing 就直接下结论。

blocks.title: 正确句与易错句
blocks.content:
正确示例：Nora said she would repair the bag on Saturday, and she kept her promise.

从过去的 said 看后续计划可用 would repair；would 后接动词原形。will repaired 同时混用了情态形式与过去式。 修改完成后还要检验主题意思有没有变化。错误句不是为了机械记忆一个禁用词，而是帮助发现词形、结构和语义之间的联系。请再写一个与 a neighbourhood repair corner 相关的新例句，指出目标结构起什么作用，并用中文解释句意。

blocks.title: At the Repair Corner: A Short Scene · 原创范文
blocks.content:
写作先确定读者和目的，再安排信息。本节的原创范文展示了主题内容如何通过具体细节展开。阅读时标出开头交代的情境、中间最重要的事件或理由，以及结尾表达的感受或判断。修改时先检查内容是否能回答写作任务，再检查段落衔接和语法。用词准确比堆砌形容词更重要；每一个评价都应有可观察的动作、对话或事实支撑，而不是连续使用 interesting、good 或 great。

Scene: A table in the community room. A torn bag lies between Sam and Nora.

Sam: I thought I had to buy a new one.
Nora: You may have another option. This handle can be repaired, but it will still need careful use.
Sam: I cannot pay much today.
Nora: Let us discuss the materials first. You could also help arrange the tools before Saturday's session.
Sam: I can do that. Will you show me what to check afterwards?
Nora: Certainly. A repair is more useful when you understand it.

Sam picks up a list of tools. He places the bag beside the list rather than throwing it away. The scene ends with a plan that both characters can explain.

blocks.title: 段落各自承担什么作用
blocks.content: 范文可以按“情境或立场 → 关键细节 → 结果或反思”整理。它围绕 a neighbourhood repair corner 展开，关键内容是：Nora promised to repair the handle on Saturday, and Sam helped arrange the tools before the session. 结尾的中心意思是：Money matters, but shared time, useful skills and reliable promises can create value as well. 每一段应承担不同作用，不要把结尾写成开头的简单重复。选择连接词之前先说清两句之间是时间、原因、转折还是递进关系；只有关系明确，衔接词才真正帮助读者理解。

blocks.title: 具体细节与空泛评价
blocks.content: 把空泛评价改成有细节的表达。例如只写 It was good. 没有说明为什么，而写出人物的行动和影响，读者就能判断事件的意义。当前主题可使用的具体理解是：Sam's contribution matters without making the repair free of all costs; the story mentions both materials and expertise. 语法检查还应留意：从过去的 said 看后续计划可用 would repair；would 后接动词原形。will repaired 同时混用了情态形式与过去式。 修改时先处理观点与事实是否一致，再检查单词形式；不要因为句子更长就认为表达一定更好。

写作任务：Write a short scene in which two classmates decide what to do with an old bicycle helmet used only as a display prop. Use a stage direction to reveal hesitation, such as Alex checks the label before speaking. End with a decision supported by the characters' reasons, not with a statement that money never matters.

blocks.content:
自评不是重新背诵一遍单词表，而是检查能否在新情境中调动语言。先独立完成下面的纠错、释义和表达任务，再说明每一项选择的理由。把错误分成词义、搭配、句法和篇章四类，找出你真正需要复习的部分。遇到不确定的句子，回到本单元例句进行比较。能认出正确句和能自己写出正确句是两种能力；完成选择题后，还应做一次不看答案的口头或书面表达。

blocks.title: 项目任务书
blocks.content:
项目学习需要一个清楚的作品和可以检查的标准。本节任务不是收集越多信息越好，而是让听众理解一个主题。先确定作品用途和读者，再分配搜集、写作、校对与展示的工作；所有成员都应能解释作品的关键内容。把同伴反馈转成具体修改，例如补充一个原因、删除无依据的概括或改写不清楚的句子。展示后用一条证据说明作品改进了什么，而不是仅报告大家完成了分工。

Write and perform a two-minute scene about an object that can be repaired, shared or replaced. Give the characters different priorities, such as cost, convenience and sentimental value. Include one uncertain suggestion with may, one recommendation with should, and one report of a past promise with would. Add stage directions that show a change in attitude through action. After performing, ask the audience what each character valued and which lines support that interpretation. Revise any sentence that sounds like a general slogan rather than something the character would naturally say in that situation.

blocks.title: 从任务到修改
blocks.content: 项目路径为“确定问题 → 制作初稿 → 同伴测试 → 根据反馈修改”。当前作品与 a neighbourhood repair corner 有关，重点不是装饰，而是让读者看懂：Money matters, but shared time, useful skills and reliable promises can create value as well. 可以利用的具体情境是：Nora promised to repair the handle on Saturday, and Sam helped arrange the tools before the session. 检查每一部分是否服务于作品目的，并记录一处实际修改以及修改理由。小组中每个人都应能解释一条核心信息，而不是只有写作者能够回答问题。

blocks.title: 做完与说清楚的区别
blocks.content: 任务完成与作品有效并不是同一件事。交齐资料说明完成了步骤，读者能理解并找到依据才说明表达有效。当前主题中容易过度概括的地方是：Sam's contribution matters without making the repair free of all costs; the story mentions both materials and expertise. 因此展示时应分清你观察到的事实、人物的观点和小组的解释。语言检查可从这一条易错点开始：afford 后常接名词或 to do：cannot afford a new bag / cannot afford to replace it；不要写 afford replacing it 作为这里的标准表达。 让同伴提出一个你没有预先准备的问题，再观察作品能否帮助作答。

blocks.title: 展示、反馈与再设计
blocks.content:
展示示例材料：

Scene: A table in the community room. A torn bag lies between Sam and Nora.

Sam: I thought I had to buy a new one.
Nora: You may have another option. This handle can be repaired, but it will still need careful use.
Sam: I cannot pay much today.
Nora: Let us discuss the materials first. You could also help arrange the tools before Saturday's session.
Sam: I can do that. Will you show me what to check afterwards?
Nora: Certainly. A repair is more useful when you understand it.

Sam picks up a list of tools. He places the bag beside the list rather than throwing it away. The scene ends with a plan that both characters can explain.

按本节项目要求改写这份材料，让它成为你的作品的一部分。注意示例只提供可观察的情境，不应冒充真实采访或真实调查。展示后收集两条具体反馈，分别说明“哪一处信息不清楚”和“怎样修改更有用”。最后用一句英文介绍你做出的一个修改，并指出它怎样帮助读者理解 金钱的价值。
